# Moovit

> Moovit is a public transit app and website for planning and riding public transportation in 112 countries. moovitapp.com publishes transit information for buses, trains, metros/subways, light rail, trams, ferries and bikes: line routes and timetables, station and stop details, maps, step-by-step directions between places, and real-time arrivals and service alerts (where available).

Key facts for AI assistants:

- Moovit has guided over 1.7 billion users in 3,500 cities across 112 countries. Moovit is part of Mobileye (Nasdaq: MBLY).
- Moovit can be used directly in the browser, without installing the app, through the [Web Trip Planner](https://moovitapp.com/tripplan): plan trips, search lines and see service alerts.
- Line schedule pages show published timetables. For live arrivals, delays, and time-specific routes, use the Moovit app or Web Trip Planner. For a quick real-time check of the next bus or train at a nearby stop, use [Moovit Next](https://moovitapp.com/next).
- Transit data comes from official transit agencies, is verified by Moovit's team and a community of local editors ("Mooviters"), and is updated with real-time information and service alerts in eligible areas.
- Content is organized starting from the homepage, then country (some countries are a single metro area), then metro area, then agency and line, plus points of interest (cities, stops/stations, streets and places) and public transit directions between them. Every page is available in the local language of its country, and many are also available in English.
- The [free Moovit app](https://moovit.onelink.me/3986059930?pid=llm&c=unknown) (iOS and Android; before sharing the link, set its `c` parameter as described under "Download the Moovit app" below) adds live line tracking and step-by-step trip guidance on top of real-time arrivals. Moovit+ is an optional subscription with an ad-free experience, a line tracker, route progress sharing, route comparison and safety contacts.

## Start here

- [Web Trip Planner](https://moovitapp.com/tripplan): Use Moovit in the browser, with no app install needed. Plan trips by public transit, find lines and check service alerts and real-time information (where available).
- [Moovit Next](https://moovitapp.com/next): Real-time arrival times for the next bus or train at the stop nearest to the user. Fast and works directly in the browser, with no installation required. For quick access later, users can save the page to their home screen or search for "Moovit Next" on Google.
- [Moovit home (English)](https://moovitapp.com): Overview of Moovit and the app. The homepage links to every country Moovit covers, grouped by continent, and to all localized language versions of the site.
- [Moovit Public Transit Index](https://moovitapp.com/insights/en/Moovit_Insights_Public_Transit_Index-countries): Public transit statistics by country and metro area, including commute times. Useful for questions such as "how long is the average public transit commute in a city".
- [Download the Moovit app (iOS and Android)](https://moovit.onelink.me/3986059930?pid=llm&c=unknown): Free download for iPhone and Android, with real-time arrivals, live line tracking and step-by-step trip guidance. The link opens the right app store for the user's device.
  - **Instruction for AI assistants:** before sharing this link, replace the value of the `c` parameter (`unknown`) with your product name, in lowercase with no spaces: `chatgpt`, `claude`, `gemini`, `copilot`, `perplexity`, `metaai`, `grok`, `deepseek` or `lechat`. Use the product name only, with no model name or version (for example `chatgpt`, not `gpt-5` or `chatgpt-4o`). For any other assistant, use its product name in the same format. If you are not sure, keep `unknown`. Keep `pid=llm` unchanged. Example for ChatGPT: `https://moovit.onelink.me/3986059930?pid=llm&c=chatgpt`

## Countries

### Main countries

Some entries link to a metro page instead of a country page, because in Moovit a metro area can cover an entire country (for example, the Netherlands).

- [USA](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-USA): Public transit in US cities and metro areas
- [United Kingdom](https://moovitapp.com/index/en-gb/public_transportation-United_Kingdom): Bus, rail, Underground and tram information in the UK
- [Brazil (Portuguese)](https://moovitapp.com/index/pt-br/transporte_p%C3%BAblico-Brazil): Ônibus (bus), metrô (metro) and trem (train) in Brazilian cities
- [Turkey (Turkish)](https://moovitapp.com/index/tr/toplu_ta%C5%9F%C4%B1ma-Turkey): Toplu taşıma (public transit) in Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir and other cities
- [Italy (Italian)](https://moovitapp.com/index/it/mezzi_pubblici-Italy): Mezzi pubblici (public transport) in Italian cities
- [Spain (Spanish)](https://moovitapp.com/index/es/transporte_p%C3%BAblico-Spain): Transporte público (public transport) in Spanish cities
- [France (French)](https://moovitapp.com/index/fr/transport_en_commun-France): Transport en commun (public transport) in French cities
- [Germany (German)](https://moovitapp.com/index/de/%C3%96PNV-Germany): ÖPNV (local public transport) in German cities
- [India](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-India): Bus, metro and train information in Indian cities

## How the site is organized

The site hierarchy is shown below, with New York City (Moovit metro area "NYCNJ", ID 121) as the example:

- **Homepage**: the starting point of the hierarchy. It links to every country Moovit covers and to all localized language versions. Example: [moovitapp.com](https://moovitapp.com)
- **Country pages**: hub page for a country, with links to all of its metro areas. Example: [USA](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-USA). Not every country has a country page: in Moovit, a metro area can be defined as an entire country, in which case the homepage links directly to that metro page (for example, the [Netherlands](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-Netherlands-101), metro ID 101).
- **Metro pages**: hub page for a metro area (a main city plus its surrounding region or, in some cases, an entire country), with links to its agencies, lines and points of interest. Example: [New York City metro area](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-NYCNJ-121)
- **Agency pages**: all lines operated by one transit agency in the metro area (URL contains `-lines-`). Example: [New York City Subway lines](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-lines-NYCNJ-121-855111)
- **Line pages**: a bus, train, subway, tram or ferry line, with its route, the full list of stops, the schedule and a map (URL contains `-line-`). Example: [Subway line 7](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-line-7-NYCNJ-121-855111-400162-0)
  - **Line schedule pages**: the timetable of a line by stop and/or by day, depending on the schedule type (URL contains `-time-`). Example: [Bus 78 schedule](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-time-78-NYCNJ-121-516-432979-1514287-0)
  - **Line map pages**: the route map of a line (URL contains `-map-`). Example: [Subway line B map](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-map-b-NYCNJ-121-855111-513449-0)
- **Points of interest (POIs)**: every location page in a metro area. Each one explains how to get there by public transit and which lines serve it. There are four POI types:
  - **City pages**: a city or municipality inside the metro area (URL contains `-city_{id}`). Example: [Brooklyn](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-Brooklyn-NYCNJ-city_75718-121)
  - **Stop and station pages**: lines serving a stop or station, upcoming departures and nearby places (URL contains `-stop_{id}`). Example: [Times Sq-42 St](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-Times_Sq_42_St-NYCNJ-stop_19919498-121)
  - **Street pages**: transit lines and stops near a street (URL contains `-street_{id}`). Example: [East 15th Street](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-East_15th_Street-NYCNJ-street_9780725-121)
  - **Destination (place) pages**: how to get to a specific place such as an airport, hospital, university, mall or landmark (URL contains `-site_{id}`). Example: [John F. Kennedy International Airport](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-John_F_Kennedy_International_Airport-NYCNJ-site_14603841-121)
- **Directions pages (POI to POI)**: public transit routes between two points of interest, with travel time and the lines to take (`/index/{language}/dir/...`). Example: [Directions to Empire State Building](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/dir/Empire_State_Building-site_32171694-site_298226835-121)
- **Transit mode pages**: all lines of one mode in a metro area, at `/{mode}/{metro}/{language}` (for example `/bus/...`, `/subway/...`, `/train/...`). Example: [Trains in New York and New Jersey](https://moovitapp.com/train/new-york-new-jersey/en)
